title: One Ant Supercolony Stretches 3,700 Miles Across Europe

scenes.text: One ant colony stretches almost four thousand miles.
They're Argentine ants, and they live along the coast of southern Europe.
The nests run from Italy to Spain, millions of them.
Ants from far-apart nests mostly welcome each other instead of fighting.
Normal ants attack strangers from other colonies. These ones don't.
Millions of nests, one giant family.

description:
One ant colony stretches almost four thousand miles.
Argentine ants form a supercolony of millions of nests along the coast of southern Europe, roughly 6,000 kilometers long.
Would you rather fight a billion ants or befriend them?
first_comment: Millions of nests and zero fights. What should humans learn from ants?
